description: This file defines the BarGridlinesRenderer class, responsible for rendering gridlines in bar chart plots within the PDFsharp library. It manages drawing gridlines along the X and Y axes, utilizing provided line formats and transformations.

classes.name: BarGridlinesRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for drawing gridlines specific to bar charts, extending the base GridlinesRenderer class.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Overrides the base Draw method to render gridlines on the plot area, including minor and major gridlines for both X and Y axes.
